_comment: Config for placement_audit — the deterministic gate for step 6 (Component Placement). Read-only: parses the .kicad_pcb and asserts placement quality before routing. Reuses layout/place_refine.py geometry (courtyard bbox + overlap math) so its checks agree with the de-collision pass that produced the board. All classification is DYNAMIC (refdes prefix + net roles), never a per-circuit list, per feedback_dynamic_derive_not_list. Cached; RESTART backend after edits. Verdict in words.
_rule_source: Master flow step 6 (Component Placement) automation checks + PCB_RULES placement section.

courtyard_overlap._rule: Rule 8 — no two footprints' courtyards may overlap (would be a courtyard DRC error + unroutable). Bbox = *.CrtYd courtyard when present, else padextents+margin, exactly like place_refine.

edge_clearance._rule: Rule 8 — every footprint must sit inside the Edge.Cuts outline minus the board's copper-to-edge clearance. No Edge.Cuts at all => warn (step 6 rule 1: define the outline).

decoupling_proximity._rule: Rule 3 — a decoupling/bypass cap must sit close to the IC power pin it serves. DYNAMIC: a cap on a power net (IR is_power) is matched to the nearest active IC on that same net and its distance checked against decoupling.max_mm.

stacked_parts._rule: Two or more footprints at the same (x,y) are unplaced / stacked at a grid slot — a placement bug, not a real layout.

decoupling._comment: Rule 3 DYNAMIC matching. cap_prefixes / ic_prefixes are GENERIC refdes classes (C = capacitor, U = IC) — a per-part signal derived from the reference designator, not a per-circuit list. A cap with a pad on a power net is treated as decoupling for the nearest IC that shares that net; it must be within max_mm.

skip_ref_prefixes._comment: Virtual / non-physical refs never audited for placement.

verdict.clean: PLACEMENT VERIFIED — {n} parts, no overlaps, inside outline, decoupling close
verdict.issues: PLACEMENT NOT CLEAN — {e} error(s), {w} warning(s) across {n} parts
verdict.no_parts: NO PARTS — board has no footprints to check
